molar_mass.compare: Which has the greater molar mass

rows.label: water
rows.description: chemical compound whose molecules are formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
rows.hook: covers most of Earth's surface and is essential to all known life

rows.label: ethanol
rows.hook: is the alcohol found in beer, wine and spirits

rows.label: caffeine
rows.description: chemical compound used as a stimulant
rows.hook: gives coffee and tea their wake-up kick

rows.label: ibuprofen
rows.hook: is a common over-the-counter painkiller sold as Advil and Motrin

rows.label: sodium bicarbonate
rows.hook: is baking soda, used in cakes and to calm heartburn

rows.label: hydrogen peroxide
rows.hook: is a pale liquid used to bleach hair and clean small cuts

rows.label: aspirin
rows.description: medication used to treat pain and decrease the risk of heart disease
rows.hook: is a pain reliever often taken in low doses to protect the heart

rows.label: nitrous oxide
rows.hook: is known as laughing gas at the dentist

rows.label: ammonia
rows.hook: is a sharp-smelling gas found in many household glass cleaners

rows.label: potassium nitrate
rows.hook: is known as saltpeter and is used in fertilizer and fireworks

rows.label: hydrochloric acid
rows.description: highly corrosive, strong mineral acid in aqueous solution
rows.hook: makes up the digestive juice in your stomach

rows.label: sulfuric acid
rows.hook: is the corrosive liquid in traditional car batteries

rows.label: sodium hydroxide
rows.hook: is known as lye and is used to make soap and unclog drains

rows.label: acetic acid
rows.hook: gives vinegar its sour taste and sharp smell

rows.label: benzene
rows.description: hydrocarbon compound consisting of a 6-sided ring
rows.hook: is a sweet-smelling, ring-shaped liquid found in petrol

rows.label: formaldehyde
rows.hook: is a pungent preservative once used for pickling lab specimens

rows.label: sodium chloride
rows.hook: is ordinary table salt

rows.label: methanol
rows.hook: is the toxic wood alcohol that is dangerous to drink

rows.label: chloroform
rows.hook: is a sweet-smelling liquid once used as an anesthetic and in old mystery stories

rows.label: nitroglycerin
rows.hook: is a heart medicine that is also the shock-sensitive liquid behind dynamite

rows.label: glycerol
rows.hook: is a thick, sweet syrupy liquid found in soap, lotions and fats

rows.label: aspartame
rows.hook: is a low-calorie sweetener in many diet sodas

rows.label: citric acid
rows.hook: gives lemons and limes their sour bite

rows.label: methane
rows.description: simplest organic molecule with one carbon atom and four hydrogen
rows.hook: is the main component of natural gas and a potent greenhouse gas

rows.label: sodium carbonate
rows.hook: is known as washing soda, used in laundry and glassmaking

rows.label: sucrose
rows.description: disaccharide made of glucose and fructose
rows.hook: is ordinary table sugar

rows.label: vitamin C
rows.description: water-soluble vitamin and antioxidant essential for collagen synthesis, immune function, and skin brightening
rows.hook: is the nutrient in oranges that helps prevent scurvy

rows.label: calcium carbonate
rows.hook: is the main material of chalk, limestone and seashells

rows.label: carbon monoxide
rows.hook: is an odorless, deadly gas from faulty heaters that home alarms detect

rows.label: silicon dioxide
rows.hook: is the main ingredient of quartz and ordinary beach sand

rows.label: sodium hypochlorite
rows.hook: is the active ingredient in household bleach

rows.label: ozone
rows.hook: forms a layer high in the sky that shields us from ultraviolet light

rows.label: nitric acid
rows.hook: is a strong corrosive liquid used to make fertilizer and rocket fuel

rows.label: ethylene glycol
rows.description: organic compound used in the making of polyester fibers and in antifreeze formulations
rows.hook: is the sweet-tasting but poisonous main ingredient of antifreeze

rows.label: magnesium sulfate
rows.hook: is sold as Epsom salts for a soothing bath soak

rows.label: sulfur dioxide
rows.hook: is a sharp gas from volcanoes and burning coal that helps cause acid rain

rows.label: propane
rows.description: chemical compound, commonly used as a fuel
rows.hook: fuels backyard barbecue grills and camping stoves

rows.label: calcium chloride
rows.hook: is spread on icy roads to melt ice

rows.label: naphthalene
rows.hook: is the smelly stuff in old-fashioned mothballs
